name: Storage folder
description: Keeps your artworks and time-lapse videos in a folder you pick, such as one a sync app keeps the same on your other devices, and brings in what changed there.

controls.label: Keep artworks in a folder
controls.description: After each save, the artwork is written to the folder as one file, as Share makes it, named after it and kept up to date. A file there the app didn't write is never written over.

controls.label: Save time-lapse videos there
controls.description: A time-lapse video you export also goes into the folder.

controls.label: Bring in changes from the folder
controls.description: Careful: as the gallery opens, a newer file there replaces the gallery's copy, and new files come in. Changed in both places, both are kept. Nothing in the folder is deleted.
